headline: Microsoft announces general availability of Microsoft Discovery on Azure, powering the development of Majorana 2 Quantum Chip
tldr: Today's AI news is dominated by major announcements from tech giants, including Microsoft's general availability of Microsoft Discovery, OpenAI's work on a 'super app', and NVIDIA's collaborations with LG Group and Doosan Group to advance physical AI and AI infrastructure. Additionally, Notion restored access to Anthropic after a service disruption, and experts discussed the evolving threat of AI-driven phishing and the need for technological sovereignty. These developments highlight the rapid progress and increasing importance of AI in various industries and aspects of life.

new_models.title: Microsoft Discovery Reaches GA on Azure
new_models.summary: Microsoft announced the general availability of Microsoft Discovery, its Azure-based platform for deploying autonomous AI agent teams in scientific R&D, powering the development of Majorana 2 Quantum Chip
new_models.why_it_matters: This development showcases Microsoft's commitment to advancing AI research and its potential to drive breakthroughs in fields like quantum computing
